Room polygons are clear interior reservations. Fill remaining plan space with unassigned opaque service/masonry volume, except the southeast entrance recess and chapel roof void.
Cut each paired door as a continuous rectangular portal between the two named directed room walls, including the interstitial volume.
At room/exterior-window connections, cut a splayed reveal joining the exterior aperture to the explicitly registered interior aperture.
Do not create separate freestanding room walls on top of exterior walls. Merge the outer face of a room boundary into the surrounding solid.
Subtract the complete octagonal stairwell through floor slabs. Upper and lower landing openings are references to that shaft.
The chapel is single-height; no first-floor slab over its clear interior.
Attic service and basement divisions are conjectural and unvisited. Do not extend the public rail into unresolved residual spaces.
The low timber gallery is OSM way 62781030, southeast of the house. Its end watchtower is way 62785404. The northern strip of main way 62782286 is a separate service range.
